row:
The North American Veterinary Community (NAVC) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to supporting and advancing veterinary professionals worldwide. As the leading provider of veterinary continuing education, the NAVC delivers essential training, tools and resources for animal health professionals to stay abreast of advances in veterinary medicine.

Through our commitment to innovation and excellence, we have developed a diverse portfolio of products and services, including educational events, virtual learning opportunities, publications, an advocacy arm and more.

Our goal is to empower veterinarians, veterinary technicians, practice managers, students and others with the skills they need throughout their careers. Our videos have been created to support this effort. 

To learn more about the NAVC’s products and brands, visit navc.com. To see our schedule of upcoming events, visit navc.com/calendar.
